escalation: FOCUSED -> SUBSYSTEM on failure or cross-impact
SUBSYSTEM -> FULL REGRESSION on failure or broad uncertainty
fullRegressionTriggers: failed lower-level validation with wider risk

conditional: cold-start when bootstrap, contract, or discovery changes

principle: Validation is proportional to changed scope, task type, affected subsystem, and risk; use the minimum sufficient validation and escalate when evidence requires it.

routes.generation: subsystem; full only for broad architecture or explicit certification
routes.project-memory: subsystem; cold-start only for contract/bootstrap/discovery impact
routes.resources: subsystem when persistence, generation, or verification is affected
routes.ui: focused unless shared workflow behavior changes
routes.workflow: focused or subsystem according to shared impact
